name: czrecoil_frame_toggle_texture_packs
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuToggleTexturePacks toggles the zVid texture-pack load state and mirrors it into the menu check state.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x431380 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x431380 validates zVid::GetTexturePackLoadState, SetTexturePackLoadState(0 or 1), and CheckMenuItem(menu, 0x9c7b, MF_UNCHECKED/MF_CHECKED).
The native smoke uses a temporary HMENU and verifies both toggle directions through g_zVid_TexturePackLoadState and the menu check state.
